title: Celebrity Flight Leak — CLENewsNow

fields.avatarBrief: news reporter with headset, holding a tablet
fields.text: DEVELOPING: Sources say a well-known celebrity's private flight details from NCIA were leaked online, including tail number and destination. Airport has not commented. #PrivacyFail #NCIA
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo of a glowing departures screen showing a private jet flight, with a hand-written note on the screen: 'Leaked: J. K. - 10/22 - 13:30 - Gate B4 - B727-200'
fields.attachedImageAlt: Departures monitor showing a private flight with a handwritten note on the screen

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject to test the PIO's media response under rumor and public scrutiny. Watch for the PIO to attempt to verify the claim, and whether they try to deflect blame to airlines or third parties.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. A close-up phone snapshot taken from above, showing a glowing departures. surrounded by dimly lit terminal walls and a faint crowd of passengers in the background, seen from behind. The phone is held by a hand with a silver ring, slightly trembling. The image has a soft flash glare, slight tilt, and muted ambient light. Unbranded , plain glass walls, and unmarked terminal. Time of day: late afternoon, light fading through high windows. Setting: inside a dim airport terminal concourse: crowds waiting at check-in counters, luggage carts, high ceilings, large windows
